# Stáj evaluation report (generated by eval/run_all.py)

**All data synthetic.** Planted schemes are planted by our own red team; numbers measure recognition of OUR scheme definitions, not real-world recall.
Operating point: case triage REVIEW, route mule_review and priority >= 30. Dev seeds [7, 101, 202, 303, 404, 505, 606] were used while building; held-out seeds [707, 808] were not used for tuning. Headline = mean over held-out seeds.

## Weak-evidence radar experiment (pre-registered: docs/PREREGISTRATION.md)

Variants: baseline = candidates only above the local probability band, cluster score by size; NEW = additionally the top 5 % of each bank's clients by a local pass-through score, matches judged by statistical improbability (Fisher + Bonferroni), priority floor for significant clusters. The `ghost_ring` is a planted ring with NO usable local signal, added after the first sweep showed no headroom.

The curve is NOT monotone: more exported candidates dilute the significance of a match (10 % and above lose the ring). Privacy cost of the weak band: about 6x more exported tokens and 8x more bytes. See LIMITATIONS.md.

## Notes

- ablation 'without_radar' is the isolated run (same pipeline without clusters)
- naive_raw_sharing pools all raw data into ONE node with thresholds calibrated per bank; it is not a guaranteed upper bound
